title: Ask stack: third pane, or the modal drawer?
body: Three asks per screen is typical. openDrawer shows #drawer over a full-viewport #scrim, so the drawer cannot show a prototype and its constraints at once.

options.label: Third pane in the view area
options.cost: ~40 lines of layout the other tabs got free from the drawer

options.label: Reuse the modal drawer
options.cost: you cannot see the screen you are ruling on

risk: B changes the blast radius of every existing drawer interaction

text: A. I need to read the constraint while I answer.
open/answered/landed must not invent a fifth hue
design-tab v2: third pane; ask states map to warn/accent/ok plus a drawn 12px icon

title: Should the schematic stay clickable once a prototype exists?

options.label: Yes — pin from either view
options.cost: two pin paths to keep working

options.label: No — prototype only
options.cost: you cannot pin a region that is not built yet

text: A — pinning from the schematic is how you flag a region before it exists.
the rail should show the open-ask count even when the surface is not selected
verification round trip; the rail count is a real follow-up
